title: Private (MEV-routed) sells accept any output: amountOutMin = 0 on V2 and V3, full and partial sells

evidence.note: buildV2SellTx encodes swapExactTokensForETH(amount, 0, path, wallet, deadline): the second argument, amountOutMin, is the literal 0
buildV3SellTx sets amountOutMinimum: 0n (:395) inside exactInputSingle, wrapped in multicall(deadline, ...)
executeFullSell builds the private-leg tx with these builders for every full-exit reason (trailing-stop, stop-loss, urgency-market-sell, anti-rug)
executePartialSell uses the same builders, so partial take-profit sells also have no output floor
submitPrivateSell sends the zero-floor tx through escalatePrivateSell (the per-chain MEV strategy) under the wallet nonce lock
contrast: the public fallback computes a real floor, computePublicMinOut(expectedOut, slippagePct), from a fresh quote; only the private leg has none

Base mevStrategy is passthrough (direct submission to the sequencer); :384 Arbitrum also passthrough; :201 ETH flashbots, :270 BSC bloxroute. On Base and Arbitrum the "private" sell is a normal sequencer submission with no floor
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Private full and partial sells accept zero minimum output

sibling_sites_checked: Every swap builder in the slice: buildV2SellTx (:351-372, minOut 0), buildV3SellTx (:378-407, minOut 0), executePublicFallbackSell (:508-564, bounded minOut via computePublicMinOut, :520-523). Callers: executeFullSell V3 (:871-872) and V2 (:874-875), executePartialSell V3 (:1509-1510) and V2 (:1512-1513). No other amountOutMin/minOut in the slice (sweep C04). The buy-side sibling (snipe minOut 0 on a failed quote) is AUD-BUY-003 / card OD-15; the deliberate private buy leg with a documented 0 floor is recorded there too.
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion. The code alone proves every private sell (full and partial, V2 and V3) is sent with no minimum output. A loss needs a condition: the price moving between the trigger and inclusion (a bundle can land blocks later, up to the confirm window per attempt), a sell-tax raised by the token owner so the swap succeeds with almost nothing instead of reverting, or a chain where the private route is a plain sequencer submission (Base, Arbitrum passthrough). Not S0: the private routing removes the ordinary public sandwich on ETH and BSC, and the loss is bounded by the position. Whether 0 is deliberate for anti-rug exits is a decision (card OD-14).
recommendation: Decide on card OD-14 whether private sells keep a zero floor, use a bounded floor from a fresh quote (computePublicMinOut), or use a bounded floor for routine exits and keep 0 only for anti-rug exits. Phase 24, after a Phase 23 real-path proof (fork replay of a rug and a taxed token). Nothing is changed in Phase 22.

steps: Trigger: pollExitStrategy (:1699) detects trailing-stop (:1750-1773), stop-loss (:1781-1797) or urgency (:1801-1815) and calls enqueueExit, then returns continue (the 5 s interval stays armed)

ExitWorker.enqueue (:1322) takes the per-position queue lock (tryEnqueuePosition, exitManager.ts:66-71) and kicks drain (:1361); drain runs the item through the installed watchdog (:1399; bot.ts:2177-2181 installs a 60 s budget)
executeFullSell (:809): routine-pause check (:824-830), per-token sell lock (:832), balanceOf (:839); a zero balance is torn down as a genuine close (:841-846)
Approval under the wallet nonce lock: ensureApproval approves exactly the balance and waits with no timeout (:871/:874 -> :419-423); the approve goes to the public mempool (AUD-EXIT-004)
Alert awaited before the sell (:893; axios with no timeout, AUD-EXIT-021), then submitPrivateSell (:909) with amountOutMin 0 (this finding)

Landed: txHash set (:911-914). Not landed: reconcile the last broadcast hash (:939-973); inconclusive -> balance-truth teardown without a public sell (:984-997); otherwise re-fetch balanceOf and sell only the held amount on the V2 public fallback with a bounded minOut (:1001-1021); V3 has no fallback (AUD-EXIT-007)
decodeReceipt (:1058-1070), then insertTrade(action sell, status sold) (:1073-1092) before the post-sell balance check

balanceOf <= dust (computeDustThreshold, :615-622) -> teardownGenuineClose (:667-675): trades buy rows still pending -> sold (updateTradeStatus matches status pending only, db.ts:325-327), clearAllTimersForToken, deleteExitState, unsubscribe anti-rug, lift routine pause; confirm alert (:1101-1105)
traces.outcome: State written on a clean full exit: a trades row (action sell, status sold, amount_in = amount actually sold); the buy row moved pending -> sold; exit_state row deleted; poll timer cleared; anti-rug unsubscribed. The sell itself carried no output floor on the private leg.

triage.note: Reproduced on the real path (plan 23-07) for all four private sell paths on ETH (Flashbots): a V2 and a V3 stop-loss full sell (another wallet dumps 30 percent of the pool's tokens) and a V2 and a V3 2x take-profit partial sell (another wallet buys with half the pool's ETH) each decode, from node.submitted and from the relay's eth_sendBundle body, with amountOutMin / amountOutMinimum 0. A floor of at least the router's own fresh quote less the configured 5 percent slippage reads looks fixed on each path, while a dust floor (1) records the bug and fails a detail (tightened in the Phase 23 code-review fix run, WR-13); a V2-only fix flips only the V2 tests. Whether 0 stays for anti-rug exits is card OD-14.
